Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Beth Mooney and Alyssa Healy will open the batting for Australia Women. Shamilia Connell will begin proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Australia Woman has completely dominated proceedings here. Meg Lanning was absolutely certain she wanted to bowl first today and her bowlers have justified her decision. All the bowlers barring Darcie Brown bowled at an economy of less than 3.5. Alana King was the pick of the bowlers taking four wickets for 8 runs in her quota of 4 overs. Tahlia McGrath contributed with three wickets and Ashleigh Gardner chipped in with two as well. The disappointment for them would be the skippers dropped catch when Alana King was on hat-trick! This should be an easy chase and Australia Women will be looking to make quick work of this total. Stay tuned for the Australia Women's reply!

Barbados Women never really got going and apart from the skipper Hayley Matthews none of the players could get into double figures. After the loss of her wicket the batters looked to be watchful but every time they looked to attack, they would end up losing a wicket. They do not have enough on the board to defend against the best team in the world. However, cricket is a funny game.
This has been an absolute rout! Barbados Women have been bowled out for a partly score of 64. Australia Women will be hoping to come out and get these runs really quickly and wrap things off!

OUT! LBW! Tahlia McGrath gets the final wicket on the final ball of the innings! That's her third wicket of the game. A yorker-length delivery, darting around the leg pole. Keila Elliott looks to flick this one but she misses and gets hit on her toe. A huge appeal there for LBW and the umpire raises her finger! Barbados Women have bundled out for 64!
Angling in, on the pads, a length ball. Shanika Bruce tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, on a length again. Shanika Bruce looks to go over cover but she misses.
Fuller this time, outside off. Keila Elliott drives it over point for a single.
A length delivery, outside off. Keila Elliott swings her bat wildly but fails to get any bat on it.
Fuller one, down the leg side. Keila Elliott looks to flick this one but she misses and gets her on her pad.
Oh, close! A shorter one, around the leg pole. Shanika Bruce looks to flick this one but she misses. The ball hits her thigh pad and rolls onto the stumps. But the bails do not fall out!
Another back of a length, spinning in, around middle. Shanika Bruce defends this one out.
Back of a length, around off. Shanika Bruce blocks it off the back foot.

A fuller ball, outside off. Shanika Bruce swings her bat at it but she misses. A huge shout for a caught behind! The umpire says no! Meg Lanning goes up for the review. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms there was no bat involved there!
Shorter one this time, around the leg pole. Shanika Bruce uses the depth of her crease and looks to pull this one but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad.
Fuller and on middle. Shanika Bruce blocks it out.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Shanika Bruce looks to sweep this one but she misses. Wide called!
Bye! A fuller ball, outside off. Shanika Bruce looks to drive this one but she misses. Alyssa Healy fails to grab the ball as well. A bye taken!
Shanika Bruce is the last batter to make her way out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Tahlia McGrath grabs her second wicket and Barbados Women have lost their ninth wicket! A length ball, attacking the stumps. Alisa Scantlebury looks to push this one towards the off side, but she misses. Teh ball goes on to shatter the stumps.
On a length, around middle. Alisa Scantlebury pushes it back to the bowler.
Nothing off the Free Hit! Outside off, on a length. Alisa Scantlebury looks to cut this away but she gets an under edge onto the deck and towards the keeper.
No ball! Fuller one again, around middle. Alisa Scantlebury digs it out towards mid off. Alisa Scantlebury has overstepped here! No ball is called! Free Hit coming up!
Pitches it up again, around middle. Alisa Scantlebury lifts this over from mid off. Not perfectly timed that one. Two taken!
A fuller ball, angling in, around the leg pole. Alisa Scantlebury looks to flick this one but she misses and gets hit on her pads.
This is short and outside off as well, Keila Elliott cuts this straight to point. That ends a wonderful spell from Alana King!
This is a fraction short and outside off, Keila Elliott goes back in the crease and fends the ball towards cover.
Goes full and into the pads, Alisa Scantlebury guides this to deep backward square leg for a single.

Full delivery outside off, Alana King clips this towards mid-wicket. They look for a single but Keila Elliott is sent back.  She could have been in serious trouble, however, Grace Harris underarms the throw over the bowler's head and they miss out on the getting a run out.
This is a fraction short and coming into the batter, Keila Elliott guides this towards square leg for a run.
Alana King goes full and just outside off, Alisa Scantlebury clips the ball towards deep sqaure leg for a run.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Keila Elliott chips it towards cover. Well short of the fielder though!
Back of a length, around off, spinning away a tad. Keila Elliott defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up, serves it full and on middle. Keila Elliott shows the full face of her bat and defends it out.
Full and on middle. Keila Elliott leans forward and blocks it out.
Fuller now, around middle. Alisa Scantlebury drags it with the inner half of her bat towards mid-wicket. Only a single!
Outside off, shorter ball. Alisa Scantlebury looks to cut this away but she misses.
Quicker in the air and served full outside off, Keila Elliott fends this back towards the bowler.

DROPPED! Alana King does not get her hat-trick! Flights this one full outside off, Keila Elliott goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge that flies towards slip. Meg Lanning dives to her right and gets both hands to it but out it goes! She has spilled it and she lies flat on the floor in dismay! All the players surround the bowler and pat her back! The skipper will be really disappointed!
Keila Elliott walks out to face the hat-trick ball! There are 6 fielder's in the inner circle on the off side.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! That is two wickets in two deliveries! Alana King flights this one even fuller on middle and leg, Shamilia Connell plays all over this one and gets hit on the pads. The finger is raised and Shamilia Connell does not even bother reviewing this one! Alana King is on a hat-trick!
Shamilia Connell walks out to bat!

OUT! PLUMB! Shakera Selman goes for a duck! Alana King flight this full and gets this to pitch in line with leg stump. Shakera Selman looks to work this leg side and plays the wrong line. Gets hit flush on the pads and the umpire raises her finger after a loud shout Shakera Selman decides to review. There is no spike on UltraEdge and three reds on Ball Tracking means the Barbados Women are seven down now!
This is full as well and outside off, Shakera Selman looks to clip this leg side but gets a leading edge towards point.
Full delivery outside off, Shakera Selman fends this towards mid on.
Beaten once again! Alisa Scantlebury is struggling to get any bat on ball here! Outside off, shorter ball. Alisa Scantlebury misses her cut shot once again.
Back of a length, outside off. Alisa Scantlebury hangs back and tries to tap this one on the off side but fails to get any bat on it.
Edged and over! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Alisa Scantlebury looks to flick this one but the ball goes off the leading edge and just away from the fielder at cover. Two taken!
Outside off, slightly short again. Alisa Scantlebury stays in her crease and looks to dab it towards point but she misses again.
Fuller now, around middle. Alisa Scantlebury tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Swing and a miss! Shorter and quicker, outside off. Alisa Scantlebury looks to cut this away but she misses.
Shakera Selman walks out to bat!

OUT! CLEANED UP! Aaliyah Alleyne goes for a wild swing and perishes! Alana King flights this full and pitching on a leg stump line, Aaliyah Alleyne looks to play across the line and gets beaten by the turn. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps and Barbados Women are six down now!
Full and angling into the batter, Alisa Scantlebury clips this towards backward square leg for a run.

A shortish ball, turning in, around the leg pole. Alisa Scantlebury looks to flick this one but she misses and gets rapped on her front pad. A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire says no! Australia Women opts for a review! No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that it is the umpire's call on the impact. The ball was clipping the leg pole, but it will be the umpire's call on wickets hitting as well.
Low full toss in line with the stumps. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to sweep and mistimes the ball towards mid-wicket for a single.
A fraction short outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne looks to cut this late and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Alana King bowls this short and outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne rocks back and cuts this towards point.
Alisa Scantlebury is the new batter in. Also, Alana King comes back to bowl.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Two wickets in the over for Ashleigh Gardner! Another one bites the dust and Barbados Women are losing their way here! A shorter one, quick and outside off. Trishan Holder hangs back and tries to cut this away but she gets a slight edge back to the keeper. Alyssa Healy takes a sharp catch. Barbados Women have lost half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: This is short and angling down leg, Trishan Holder looks to pull and misses. A stifled appeal but the umpire says not out.
Similar delivery served outside off, Trishan Holder taps this towards cover.
Serves this full outside off, Trishan Holder lunges forward and fends this towards the cover fielder.
Goes short and outside off, Trishan Holder goes back to hit this and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Trishan Holder is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Barbados Women in serious trouble! Every time they look to attack they lose a wicket! Ashleigh Gardner serves this full outside off, Kyshona Knight charges down the wicket and looks to heave this leg side. Mistimes it in the air straight to short mid-wicket where Grace Harris takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Grace Harris b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: This time it's in the gap! Wide of off again, shorter one. Aaliyah Alleyne cuts it towards sweeper cover. Two taken!
Width on offer, shorter ball. Aaliyah Alleyne cuts it towards point. Not in the gap though!
Back to over the wicket, fuller one, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne drives it uppishly at mid off. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce.
Angling in, on a length from 'round the wicket, on the thigh pad. Kyshona Knight tucks it towards short fine leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne cuts it through point and rotates the strike.
Very full this time, around middle and leg. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to flick this one but she gets an inside edge back onto her boot.
Goes back to bowling full outside off, Kyshona Knight knocks this towards mid off. Ashleigh Gardner concedes just 3 runs from her first over.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne stays back and cuts this towards short third man for a run.
Ashleigh Gardner continues bowling full, outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne happy to defend this towards the cover fielder.
Goes full and angles it in from outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne fends this towards cover.
This is full as well and outside off, Kyshona Knight taps this towards point and takes a quick run.
Ashleigh Gardner begins with a loopy delivery bowled full outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne pushes at it and guides it toward deep point for a single.
Slightly shorter this time, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne cuts it towards point for single. End of a successful first over from Tahlia McGrath!
Length ball, around the off pole. Aaliyah Alleyne drives and fins the fielder at mid off.
Pitches it up now, around off. Kyshona Knight drives it towards cover and takes a single.
Tad shorter, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne dabs it towards third man for a single. She gets off the mark!

OUT! TAKEN! Tahlia McGrath strikes in her first over and she gets rid of Kycia Knight! Barbados Women are in deep trouble here! She serves it on a length, around middle. Kycia Knight backs away and pulls this towards the fielder at deep square leg. Megan Schutt there takes a good catch. Barbados Women are 3 down now! Aaliyah Alleyne is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Megan Schutt b Tahlia McGrath

Commentary.Commentary: Tahlia McGrath begins with a length ball, angling in, around the pads. Kyshona Knight tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Tahlia McGrath has been in outstanding all-round form off late and a lot will depend on her as the tournament progresses.
Flights this on a yorker length and in line with the stumps, Kycia Knight puts her bat down in time and digs the ball out.
This is short and wide outside off, Kyshona Knight cuts this towards backward point for a single.
Flights this full and in line with the stumps. Kyshona Knight flicks this towards square leg.
Alana King serves this full outside off, Kyshona Knight fends this back towards the bowler.
Kyshona Knight comes to the crease.

LBW! Deandra Dottin has to depart! Alana King goes full once again and just outside off, Deandra Dottin looks to sweep this fine and gets hit straight on the pad. The players are all up in appeal and the umpire raises her finger. Deandra Dottin decides to review this. UltraEdge shows there is no bat involved and three reds on Ball Tracking means that Deandra Dottin's labored innings comes to an end!
Alana King begins with a flighted delivery full outside off, Deandra Dottin goes across the stumps and paddles this towards fine leg for a brace.
Alana King has been brought into the attack.

Edgy runs there! Slower through the air, full and outside off. Kycia Knight strides forward and looks to block this one but the goes off the outside edge away from the keeper and towards third man. Two taken!
Fuller, outside off, flatter as well. Kycia Knight leans forward and pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, around off. Kycia Knight stays in the crease and pushes it towards cover.
Slightly shorter now, around off. Kycia Knight makes room and cuts it through point for a brace.
Another fuller one, outside off. Kycia Knight advances down the pitch and lifts it over mid off. Two taken!
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Kycia Knight leans forward and blocks it out.

FOUR! Finally gets her first boundary on her 20th delivery! This will make her feel a lot better. Darcie Brown goes full outside off, Deandra Dottin makes room and thumps this between mid off and cover for a boundary! This should release some pressure that has been building on her!
Darcie Brown bangs this short and angling down leg, Deandra Dottin looks to pull but misses. This is really close to being called wide.
Goes full once again in line with the stumps, Deandra Dottin fends this towards mid on.
Serves this is full and wide outside off, Deandra Dottin wings once again and misses.
This is on a good length and angling in from outside off, Deandra Dottin fends this back towards the bowler's left.
Darcie Brown bangs this in a fraction short outside off, Deandra Dottin swings and mistimes it in the air and just short of mid off.
WIDE! Strays down the leg from a good length, Deandra Dottin swings and misses. Called wide by the umpire.
Outside off, tad fuller. Kycia Knight steps down the pitch and carves this one over cover-point. Two taken!
Fraction shorter, around middle. Deandra Dottin tucks it towards square leg. A single taken!
Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Deandra Dottin looks to flick this one but she misses and gets hit on her pads. A stifled appeal there for LBW but the umpire says no.
Outside off, angling away, outside off. Deandra Dottin tries to slash this away but she misses.
Fuller again, around middle. Kycia Knight drives it towards the fielder at mid on. The fielder there fumbles which allows the batters to sneak in a run.
Lovely ball! A length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Kycia Knight looks to have a poke at it but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Pulls her length back a fraction and serves this outside off, Deandra Dottin fends this towards point. Ends a successful over from Darcie Brown.
Kycia Knight walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Darcie Brown has been expensive but gets the first wicket! Darcie Brown bangs this in short, Hayley Matthews charges down the wicket and swings. Gets the top edge and goes high into the sky. Grace Harris at mid-wicket, gets under this one and takes this one comfortably! Hayley Matthews departs after a short cameo and Australia Women have drawn first blood!
Commentary.Howout: c Grace Harris b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Darcie Brown serves this full and outside off, Hayley Matthews swings in line with the delivery and misses. Gets beaten on the outside edge by the swing.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Hayley Matthews fends this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Two in a row! Darcie Brown compensates and goes short outside off, Hayley Matthews rocks back and pulls this towards the deep square leg boundary for another boundary!
FOUR! What a shot! Darcie Brown goes full outside off, Hayley Matthews thumps this to the right of covers and finds the gap. Gets to the deep cover boundary for four more runs!
Yes, she can! Fuller ball, outside off. Deandra Dottin drives it to the fielder at mid off. Good start from Jess Jonassen!
Another loopy ball, full, around off. Deandra Dottin lunges forward and defends it out. Can she begin with a maiden?
Make that four dots! Tosses it up again, full and around off. Deandra Dottin presses forward and blocks it out.
Shorter ball again, around off. Deandra Dottin stays in her crease and defends this one out. 3 dots on the trot!
Tad shorter now, around off again. Deandra Dottin blocks it off the back foot.
A fuller ball, spinning away, outside off. Deandra Dottin leaves it alone.
Jess Jonassen comes into the attack.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Hayley Matthews knocks this towards cover-point.
No run, On a good length outside off, Hayley Matthews fends this towards the point fielder.
FOUR! This has been dispatched! Darcie Brown goes full outside off, Hayley Matthews moves her front foot out of the way and plunders this past cover for the second boundary of the over!
Darcie Brown goes short and cramps the batter for space. Deandra Dottin looks to pull and misses. Hits her and rolls over to the leg side for a single.
This is full and angled into the pads, Hayley Matthews clips this towards deep backward square leg for a single.

FOUR! First boundary for Barbados Women! Darcie Brown begins with a short delivery wide outside off, Hayley Matthews has room to swing her arms. Lofts this over the backward point fielder who dives to her left. Four runs to deep backward point.
Ends with a good-length delivery outside off, Deandra Dottin fends this towards cover. 2 runs of the first over.
On a good length and outside  off, Deandra Dottin pushes at the ball and gets a thick outside edge towards backward point.
Serves this on a good length and angling into the stumps, Hayley Matthews works this towards deep square leg for a single.

Tad shorter, around middle. Hayley Matthews looks to tuck it away towards square leg but she misses. The ball hit her thigh pad and goes towards point. Deandra Dottin leaves her crease for a single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the replay shows that Deandra Dottin is well in.
Full once again and angling in from outside off, Hayley Matthews fends this back towards the bowler.
Megan Schutt begins with a fuller ball, angling in, around middle. Deandra Dottin tucks it through square leg for a single. Barbados Women and Deandra Dottin are up and running!

We are all set for action to get underway! The players are out in the middle. Deandra Dottin and Hayley Matthews will open the batting for Barbados Women. Megan Schutt will begin with the ball. Let's go!

Barbados Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews (C), Kycia Knight (WK), Kyshona Knight, Aaliyah Alleyne, Trishan Holder, Alisa Scantlebury, Shakera Selman, Shamilia Connell, Keila Elliott (In for Aaliyah Williams), Shanika Bruce.

Australia Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Tahlia McGrath, Rachael Haynes, Ashleigh Gardner, Grace Harris, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

In the previous game of this tournament between India Women and Pakistan Women we witnessed some showers. That game was reduced to an 18-over-per-side match but the weather seems much better now. Let's hope it stays that way and we face no interruptions. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
